title: Armadillo to tortoise
description: This resource pack replaces armadillos with tortoise in certain biomes
body:
This resource pack replaces armadillos with tortoise in certain biomes:
-     desert
-     swamp
-     mangrove swamp
-     river
-     stony shore
-     beach
-     wooded badlands
-     savanna plateau

You will need optifine or similar mods to see this change
